name: openscope
description: Open-source analytics for the agent customer journey: which AI agents use your product, what they came to do, where they stop, and what to fix.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p examples/ledgerly
scripts.build: npm run build -w @openscope/core && npm run build -w @openscope/sdk && npm run build -w @openscope/web
scripts.start: npm run build -w @openscope/web --silent -- --logLevel error && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --conditions=source packages/server/src/main.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build -w @openscope/core -w @openscope/sdk --silent && mkdir -p packages-dist && npm pack -w @openscope/core -w @openscope/sdk --pack-destination packages-dist --silent
